get.description:
Lite-friendly token-gated device bootstrap script.

The script performs a local identity guard before the invite is consumed.
This prevents an already-enrolled phone from accidentally overwriting its
local agent identity with a different invite.

schema.title: Role

parameters.description: Single-use invite token. Omission returns a sanitized 400 response.

403.description: The invite or bootstrap request is not authorized.

410.description: The invite has expired, was revoked, or was already used.

post.description:
Request a supervised restart of a Lite fleet agent.

The UI never executes PM2 or shell commands. This endpoint records an auditable
command and publishes it over the node-agent NATS command subject. If the node
is offline, the command remains visible as queued; delivery requires the agent
to reconnect to NATS.
